_about: Public-domain Huldreich Zwingli (1484-1531), the reformer of Zurich, in English for the Word Hoard: The Christian Education of Youth (1899), Selected Works, translated for the first time, edited by Samuel Macauley Jackson (Philadelphia, 1901), and The Latin Works and the Correspondence of Huldreich Zwingli, edited by Jackson and others (3 vols., 1912-1929). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 81 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
